contexts.text: Yet women have the right of choosing one of their suitors. CL 296:end.
The parents acquire Knowledges about the suitor.
If a daughter were to consent of herself to her urgent suitor...
She is unqualified to ferret out such things as belong to the habits and peculiarities of her suitor.
Like a virgin who accepts rings from a number of suitors...
Virgins who do not regard scortations as wicked, but abstain from them because the resulting bad name would turn away suitors.
